My visual data story

My phone use?

I logged 50 phone use sessions from march 27 to march 30 and may 12 in 2026, recording the duration, purpose, and whether each session increase or decrease my productivity. Below here is some of the data:

Does session purpose impact productivity?

Entertainment and Social Media sessions usually decreased productivity, while Work/Study sessions increased productivity. Utility sessions had little to no effect either way.

plot1

Does session length matter?

Sessions under 50 minutes show little to no effect on productivity. It is the longer sessions where productivity starts to get affected. As the boxplot shown below:

plot2

When were sessions logged?

I usually log the sessions at 12pm and 4pm but this doesn’t change anything >_<.

plot3

How Phone Usage Affects Productivity in Daily Life

The pattern is clear that Work/Study would increased productivity, while Entertainment most often decreased it by distracting us from the things we needed to do. Short sessions under 50 minutes tend to be harmless regardless of purpose but as it get longer it will affect on our productivity and daily routines. We need to be aware of our screen time as it is important for maintaining balance in everyday life.
